summary: The table presents various hyperparameters for a transformer model configuration. It includes parameters such as the number of layers (N), model dimension (d_model), feed-forward dimension (d_ff), number of attention heads (h), key and value dimensions (d_k, d_v), dropout probability (P_drop), label smoothing (epsilon_ls), and training steps. The table compares different configurations, including a setup with positional embedding instead of sinusoids, highlighting variations in dimensions and training steps. Notable configurations include a model with 6 layers, 512 model dimension, and 100K training steps, and another with 6 layers, 1024 model dimension, and 300K training steps.
